spec.title: HashiStack / Nodes
spec.description: Host-level saturation and errors from node_exporter on every Consul, Nomad and Vault machine: CPU, memory, disk, network, clock, SELinux and the platform systemd units.

spec.title: Hosts up
spec.description: node_exporter targets answering.

spec.title: Hottest CPU
spec.description: Busiest selected host's non-idle CPU.

spec.title: Fullest memory
spec.description: Highest memory use among the selected hosts.

spec.title: Fullest root FS
spec.description: Highest root filesystem use. HostDiskFilling fires above 90%.

spec.title: Peak load / core
spec.description: 5-minute load average divided by CPU count; above 1 means runnable work is queueing.

spec.title: OOM kills (range)
spec.description: Kernel OOM-killer invocations in the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Platform units not active
spec.description: consul, nomad, vault, vault-agent@*, node_exporter, podman-image-gc.timer units that are not active (the image-gc oneshot service is expected to be inactive between timer runs).

spec.title: Clocks unsynchronised
spec.description: Hosts whose kernel reports the clock unsynchronised. Raft, TLS and JWT validation all assume synchronised clocks.

spec.title: Not SELinux enforcing
spec.description: Hosts not in SELinux enforcing mode (ADR-0134 relies on container_t).

spec.title: Conntrack peak use
spec.description: Fullest connection-tracking table. A full table silently drops new connections.

spec.title: TCP retransmit ratio
spec.description: Retransmitted / sent TCP segments over the selected hosts.

spec.title: NIC errors + drops /s
spec.description: eth0 receive/transmit errors and drops per second.

spec.title: CPU busy by host
spec.description: Current non-idle CPU per host.

spec.title: Memory used by host
spec.description: Current memory use per host.

spec.title: Root FS used by host
spec.description: Current root filesystem use per host.

spec.title: CPU busy
spec.description: Non-idle CPU per host.

spec.title: CPU by mode (selected hosts)
spec.description: Where the busy time goes. High iowait points at disk; high steal at the hypervisor.

spec.title: Load average per core
spec.description: load5 / cores. Sustained values above 1 mean CPU queueing.

spec.title: iowait + steal
spec.description: CPU time waiting on I/O or stolen by the hypervisor.

spec.title: Processes running / blocked
spec.description: Runnable and uninterruptibly blocked processes over the selected hosts.

spec.title: Memory used
spec.description: 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal. These hosts run without swap: at 100% the OOM killer acts.

spec.title: Memory composition (selected hosts)
spec.description: How memory is spent across the selected hosts.

spec.title: Major page faults
spec.description: Faults that had to read from disk; a rise under memory pressure precedes thrashing.

spec.title: Root FS used
spec.description: Root filesystem use per host.

spec.title: Root FS free in 24h (projected)
spec.description: Linear projection of free space 24h ahead from the last 6h trend. Negative = fills within a day.

spec.title: Disk utilisation
spec.description: Share of time the device had I/O in flight.

spec.title: Disk throughput
spec.description: Bytes read and written per host.

spec.title: Disk latency (avg per op)
spec.description: Average time per completed read/write. Raft (Consul/Nomad/Vault) is sensitive to write latency.

spec.title: eth0 receive
spec.description: Bytes received on the primary interface.

spec.title: eth0 transmit
spec.description: Bytes sent on the primary interface.

spec.title: TCP retransmit ratio
spec.description: Retransmitted / sent segments; a lossy WireGuard or VPC path shows here first.

spec.title: TCP sockets
spec.description: Open TCP sockets and TIME_WAIT per host.

spec.title: Conntrack table use
spec.description: Connection-tracking entries / limit. The Nomad bridge and Consul tproxy NAT every flow.

spec.title: Listen drops / overflows
spec.description: SYNs dropped because an accept queue was full.

spec.title: Platform units not active
spec.description: Platform units that should be running but are not. Empty is healthy.

spec.title: Active platform units per host
spec.description: Count of active platform units: servers run fewer than clients.

spec.title: Clock offset
spec.description: Kernel-reported offset from the time source.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since boot; a host that rebooted unexpectedly sorts first.

spec.title: OS / kernel
spec.description: Kernel release per host (value is always 1).
